mentions.name: Balbor (C roguelike)
mentions.description: A roguelike game written in C that is playable in the browser via Emscripten. It is still rough around the edges and unbalanced, lacks a "you won" screen, but is fully playable.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building a roguelike in c. It's playable on the web with emscripten. It's still a bit rough around the edges+not balanced and doesn't even have a "you won" screen yet but it works
